## Ctx.broadcastMedia() method

Sends a media message to multiple users in bulk.

**Signature:**

```typescript
broadcastMedia(ids: number[], languageCode: string[], keyboard?: IInBoKb, data?: IData, baseId?: string, options?: IOptReplyPhoto | IOptReplyVideo | IOptReplyAudio | IOptReplyDocument | IOptReplyAnimation | IOptReplyVoice | IOptReplyVideoNote | IOptReplySticker | IOptReplyLocation | IOptReplyContact, throwError?: boolean): Promise<void>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

Media type and payload are inferred from the template `<media>` block. Automatically throttles after 30 messages to respect Telegram rate limits. Uses each user's specified language code for template rendering.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  const userIds = [123456, 789012]
  const langs = ["en", "id"]
  await this.broadcastMedia(userIds, langs)
}
```
